definitions.explanation: A state of being full of life and activity; energetic atmosphere.

examples.notes: {活気|かっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ is a common expression

examples.japanese: ⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{活気|かっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あふれていた→溢れる：04250_afureru⟧。
examples.english: The market was full of energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{活気|かっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: To bring vitality back to the company.

notes:
{活気|かっき} means vigor, liveliness, or energy. It describes an energetic atmosphere or state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {活気|かっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be lively/energetic)
- {活気|かっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あふれる→溢れる：04250_afureru⟧ (to be full of vitality)
- ⟦{活気|かっき}づく→活気づく：noentry⟧ (to become lively)
- {活気|かっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧ (to regain vitality)

USAGE:
- Describes places: {活気|かっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧ (lively town)
- Describes atmospheres: {活気|かっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧ (energetic workplace)
- Describes economy: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{活気|かっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (the economy lacks vigor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧: personal energy/health
- {活気|かっき}: atmosphere/environment energy
- ⟦{活力|かつりょく}→活力：05525_katsuryoku⟧: vitality (more formal)
